properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 supplies SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations; it is a transitive dependency of elliptic (required alongside crypto-js and sha.js by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28, the Cosmos wallet library this provider uses) and is bundled into the minified trust_min.js that android/lib ships into dapp webviews. Changeable here via the workspace dependency graph. Declaration only — no first-party call site imports hash.js directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@4.2.0 (yarn.lock:3295) is required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28 (yarn.lock:1425); its MD5 implementation ships inside the minified trust_min.js webview bundle. Changeable here by removing/bumping the keplr crypto dependency. First-party TS has no direct crypto-js import, so MD5 rides along in the bundle rather than being called by application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 as provided by crypto-js@4.2.0, required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28; ships inside the minified trust_min.js webview bundle. Same dependency chain as the MD5 finding — one library, several weak legacy hashes. Changeable here via the dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.2.0 exports secp256k1 ECDSA — the signature curve the Cosmos/Ethereum provider stack signs transactions with (see the source-site object for WebAppInterface.kt/CosmosProvider.ts). One of several noble/curves copies resolved in yarn.lock (~1.4.0/^1.4.0 appear too). Shipped inside the minified trust_min.js bundle. Changeable here; the secp256k1 usage itself is quantum-unsafe signing (deadline risk, ML-DSA-65 migration).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves@1.2.0 provides Ed25519 (with secp256k1, X25519, P-256 and others). Pulled in transitively (Solana/@noble stack per yarn.lock); no first-party TS import found — message/transaction signing is delegated to the native wallet — but ed25519 implementation strings are verified present in the shipped WebView bundle (android/lib/src/main/res/raw/trust_min.js), so the algorithms ship with the app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 is the legacy ECDSA library, required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28 (yarn.lock:1426) and the ethers-v5 chain; its secp256k1/P-256 ECDSA code ships in the trust_min.js webview bundle. Unmaintained upstream (last release 2023, known pitfalls in signature malleability); @noble/curves is its maintained successor already present in the same graph. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.2.0 exports secp256r1/P-256 alongside secp256k1; the NIST curve is part of the library surface shipped in the trust_min.js bundle whether or not the web3 code selects it. Declaration-level asset: presence is what the inventory records; no first-party P-256 call site found. Changeable here via the dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 exports ECDH key agreement (elliptic.ec derive); required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28 and the ethers-v5 chain, so its ECDH surface ships in the trust_min.js webview bundle. Quantum-unsafe key agreement (Shor). No first-party ECDH call site found — presence-level asset from the dependency graph. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 (yarn.lock:6859) provides X25519 scalar-multiplication key agreement (nacl.scalarMult); required by @metamask/* packages in the lockfile (yarn.lock:1476) and at :2196. Ships in the trust_min.js webview bundle. Quantum-unsafe key agreement; ML-KEM-768 is the migration target. Changeable here via the dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@4.2.0 provides AES (CBC/ECB/CTR), DES/3DES, HMAC, PBKDF2, MD5, SHA-1/2. Transitive dependency; no first-party TS call site found. Note for posture: crypto-js is unmaintained (repo archived 2023; 4.2.0 is the final release) — any future use inherits stale defaults; not visibly bundled into the shipped trust_min.js.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.3.2's SHA-256 — the implementation is verified shipped inside the app: the minified bundle android/lib/src/main/res/raw/trust_min.js contains the @noble/hashes SHA-2 class code (SHA-256 round constants and IV seen). Consumed by the JS provider stack (e.g. @solana/web3.js internals); no direct first-party TS import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: BLAKE3 available in the declared hash library @noble/hashes@1.3.2. Availability only — no first-party call site, and no blake strings found in the shipped Android bundle, so the module is not currently compiled into the product. Kept because the library ships it and any future import reaches it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 provides SHA-3/Keccak — the Ethereum message-and-address hashing primitive this provider demonstrably uses on the native side too (wallet.core.jni Hash.keccak256 in the Android demo, Hash.keccak256 in the iOS provider). Hashes are the least PQ-urgent class; this entry documents which SHA-3 ships in the bundle. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 implements crypto_secretbox = XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD; required by @metamask/* packages in the lockfile and bundled into trust_min.js. The AE is quantum-safe (symmetric) but the object records which cipher the shipped bundle carries. Changeable here via the dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3 — XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox/box, Ed25519 signatures, X25519, SHA-512. Dependency of @solana/web3.js 1.91.8 (packages/solana/package.json). No first-party TS call site (signing is delegated native), but secretbox/poly1305 strings are verified present in the shipped WebView bundle (trust_min.js), so tweetnacl's algorithms ship in the product.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@4.2.0 (yarn.lock:3295) is the crypto provider library required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28 — its MD5/SHA-1/SHA-2/AES/HMAC/PBKDF2 implementations all ship inside the minified trust_min.js bundle the Android library injects into webviews. This entry is the library itself; the algorithm-level objects (MD5, SHA-1) reference the same package. Changeable here by dropping the keplr dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: sha.js@2.4.11 — pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512. Transitive dependency in yarn.lock; no first-party import found in the workspace TS, and not among the algorithm strings verified in the shipped Android bundle. Availability only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 (yarn.lock:3442) is the legacy EC crypto provider required by @keplr-wallet/crypto@0.12.28 and ethers-v5 packages; its secp256k1 ECDSA, P-256 and ECDH code ships in the trust_min.js webview bundle. Unmaintained upstream — a dependency inventory should flag exactly this. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 — the shipped bundle's hash library: SHA-2 (SHA-256 class code verified on disk in trust_min.js), Keccak/SHA-3, RIPEMD-160 strings present; also exports scrypt/pbkdf2/blake modules not seen bundled. Consumed transitively by the JS provider stack (@solana/web3.js etc.).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 — SHA-1/2 and RIPEMD utilities, pulled in as elliptic's hashing dependency (elliptic is also declared in yarn.lock, judged in the other shard). No first-party call site found; availability only in the build supply chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.2.0 is the modern EC crypto provider in the provider's JS dependency graph (secp256k1/P-256/Ed25519 exports); its code ships inside the minified trust_min.js bundle. Several noble/curves versions are resolved in the lockfile; this entry pins the 1.2.0 copy. Changeable here.
